trace_summary: ThermalStatus_OnCanRx filters for the extended thermal-status frame with identifier 0x18FF62A1 and an 8-byte payload. It reads bytes 0–1 as a signed little-endian temperature value, scales it by 0.01, and stores it in g_thermal.max_cell_temp_c. Byte 2 is read as an unsigned pump-duty value, scaled by 0.5, and stored in g_thermal.pump_duty_pct. The excerpt contains no encoder for this message.

trace_summary: ChargeLimits_Transmit constructs the standard 8-byte frame with identifier 0x521. It converts the charge and discharge current limits to unsigned raw values by dividing by 0.1, then writes them in little-endian order to bytes 0–1 and 2–3, respectively. Bytes 4–7 are set to zero before Can_Send transmits the frame.
